title: Singaporeans and Permanent Residents who have Appealed for Their Foreigner Relatives to Enter Singapore Since Circuit Breaker
what_it_is: Singaporeans and Permanent Residents who have Appealed for Their Foreigner Relatives to Enter Singapore Since Circuit Breaker

sections.label: Foreign family entry applications
sections.summary: ICA processed about 18,600 entry applications for foreign family members of SCs and PRs, rejecting 3% mainly for lack of proof of SC or PR nexus.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 1 April 2020 to 31 January 2021, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) processed about 18,600 applications for entry of foreign family members of SCs and PRs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The remaining 3% were rejected, mainly because the applicant was unable to provide proof of SC or PR nexus.

sections.label: SHN and swab cost appeals
sections.summary: ICA processed 371 appeals for waiver of SHN stay or COVID-19 swab test costs, with about 60% successful and the rest withdrawn or unsuccessful.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 1 April 2020 to 31 January 2021, ICA processed 371 appeals for waiver of costs for SHN stays or COVID-19 swab tests for family members of SCs and PRs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: About 60% of these appeals were successful, while the remaining were either withdrawn or were unsuccessful.
